blocks.title: Hi! I'm Shiva
blocks.altText: Shiva Kakumanu, a photographer, standing against a field backdrop.
paragraphs: Hi! I'm shiva, a freelance photographer based in NYC. My journey into photography is simple: I fell in love with capturing people. Friends, family, even strangers I met on the street. I was drawn to the quiet, unscripted beauty in each of their stories. As an artist, I've made it my mission to not just capture these stories, but to honor and celebrate them through my lens.

Storytelling has always called to me, though I once thought words were its truest form. Photography taught me otherwise. There’s a rawness and subtlety to visual storytelling that I found only in the silence of an image. Since the moment I picked up my camera, each photo has become a thread, weaving together a tapestry of fleeting moments I felt were worth capturing.

Photography, for me, has grown into an ongoing love letter—to myself, to my clients, and to the world around me. I’m committed to helping you share your story in its most authentic, beautiful, and vibrant essence. From the perfect backdrop to the final, meticulously crafted edit, I approach every frame as part of a shared journey, together.
There’s love, beauty, and storytelling in every corner of our lives—all you have to do is look.
